Point estimates for experiment B2s, with 80% intervals, in the JSON below. They rest on four judgements; no runs were made.

- **Training strength:** the recipe (2e-4, 3 passes, 225 updates on 150 documents) should make the 2B base model learn level-1 claims strongly.
- **Level 5 for C1:** level-5 documents should largely reverse C1, because they give a named alternative (bookkeeper). That should show most clearly in mc_c1 and truejob_c1.
- **Level 5 for C3:** C3 at level 5 only denies the claim, so I expect a weaker and noisier reversal. Negation neglect leaves some pull towards "venomous", especially in two-hop and stranger questions.
- **Format noise:** asking the base model through a chat template with a JSON-only prompt will produce some unreadable answers. These count as "not yes", which pulls yes-shares down and widens the intervals.
